title: Rav Yehudah, Son of Rav Yehoshua

paragraphs: Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yehoshua.

[Avodah Zarah 43b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.43b.3) mentions him saying: “I heard it in Rabbi Yehoshua’s lecture.” Hyman calls this a printing error and proposes following the Rif and Rosh: “Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua said: I heard it in Abaye’s lecture: ‘Do not make with Me’—do not make Me.” Hyman says that the reading is likewise found on 42b there. [Rosh Hashanah 24b](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.24b.4) attributes the teaching to Rav Huna son of Rav Idi; Hyman proposes Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua, reporting that reading from Dikdukei Soferim there.[^1]

notes.text: Avodah Zarah 43b names Rav Yehudah son of Rav Yehoshua and Rabbi Yehoshua as lecturer. Rosh Hashanah gives Rav Huna son of Rav Idi and Abaye as lecturer. Hyman reports his preferred form from the Rif, Rosh and Dikdukei Soferim.
